title.zh: 游乐设施安全（豁免）命令 2011
title.vi: Lệnh An toàn trò chơi giải trí (Miễn trừ) 2011
title.th: คำสั่งความปลอดภัยเครื่องเล่น (การยกเว้น) 2011

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Order may be cited as the Amusement Rides Safety (Exemption) Order 2011 and shall come into operation on 1st July 2011.

heading.en: Exemption from appointment of ride manager if at least one ride manager remains

text.en: 2. Where a ride manager of an amusement ride vacates his appointment, the holder of the operating permit of that amusement ride shall be exempt from section 16(2)(b) of the Act in respect of appointing another ride manager to substitute the first-mentioned ride manager, if at least one suitably qualified and trained ride manager remains appointed under section 16(1) of the Act in respect of that amusement ride after the first-mentioned ride manager has vacated his appointment.
